title: Freelance Hourly & Day Rate Calculator (After Taxes & Time Off)
meta_description: Calculate the minimum freelance hourly and day rate needed to hit your take-home income goal after taxes, overhead expenses, vacation weeks, and non-billable time.
lead: Translate your target take-home salary into a sustainable hourly rate and day rate that covers taxes, software overhead, vacation, and unbilled admin hours.

inputs.label: Billable Utilization (%)
inputs.hint: Typical solo consultants bill 60%–75% of total hours; the rest goes to sales, proposals, and admin.

formula_html:
Required Gross Revenue = (Target Net Income / (1 - Tax Rate)) + Annual Overhead.

Billable Hours / Year = (52 - Weeks Off) × Weekly Hours × Utilization%. Dividing Required Gross Revenue by Billable Hours yields your break-even hourly quote.

faqs.q: Why should billable utilization be below 100%?
faqs.a: No independent consultant bills all 40 hours every week. Client prospecting, invoicing, bookkeeping, and skill maintenance usually consume 25%–40% of your working week.

faqs.q: How does a W-2 salary compare to a freelance hourly rate?
faqs.a: A common rule of thumb is dividing an equivalent full-time salary by 1,000 rather than 2,080 to account for employer payroll taxes, health insurance, paid leave, and unbilled bench time.
